body.x: FR Medical Lab will exhibitplasma beauty devices at CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition inLas Vegas, USA, from January 8 (Tue) to January 11 (Fri), 2019.

FR Medical Lab participates inthis exhibition and manufactures a wide range of products using Plasmatechnology for general living such as household skin beauty equipment, plasmamask, scalp care equipment using plasma.

Established in 2018, thecompany’s product "Dr. Plasine" is a non-contact, low-temperatureplasma ion generator that generates sterilized plasma ions to help sterilizeand regenerate skin. It is the world's first non-contact type plasma equipmentthat can be safely used for children without pain.

Features of the product include:▲ The world's first non-contact type plasma device ▲ Scientific clinical effectcompared to similar products ▲ No pain, can improve both child and adult atopy▲ Intuitive and human friendly UI 6. Ozone, radon, electromagnetic safetyverification.
